Maria Chen: Quick thread — we need a lightweight screener for the new Foundry Beta (private deploy). Target 6 partners, mixed sectors, tight feedback in first month. Can we make a 2-minute intake?
Rajesh Nair: Yes. Keep it 4 scored items + 2 hard gates. Fast to review.
Diego Morales: Proposed scored axes (1-5): infra readiness (30%), data sensitivity (25%), integration velocity (25%), feedback bandwidth (20%).
Hana Lee: For infra readiness include ephemeral staging and ability to provide test payloads. If they can't, reduce score.
Priya Singh: Hard gates idea: (1) pilot start <=30 days, (2) at least 1 eng contact committed. Both must be yes.
Maria Chen: Recruitment copy (short): "Foundry Beta — 4w feedback + 2w wrap. Weekly async notes + 1x 60m review. Incentive: $3k infra credit or co-marketing." Keep <100 words.
Rajesh Nair: Add a simple checkbox: 'willing to run monthly mini-eval (20 prompts)' — important for regressions.
Diego Morales: Success signals proposal: 
- Active participation: >=70% of touchpoints
- Insight density: >=6 actionable items in first 4 weeks
- Conversion: >=1 partner moves to pilot/reserved within 90 days
- Stability: no Sev1 caused by pilot integration

Hana Lee: Ops: I'll template a single-GPU runbook and a reduced-memory model variant. infra-bot: created channel #foundry-1717759999-ops (auto).
Priya Singh: Intake fields: company, use case, expected qps, infra, data sensitivity, pilot window (checkbox), eng contact (name/email), commitment to eval (checkbox).
Maria Chen: Decision flow: PM scores & nominates, Eng validates infra, Legal checks addendum. We will tag risk as low/med/high so SRE attention is prioritized.
Rajesh Nair: I'll assemble a seed list and run the screener tonight. Post scores here.
Maria Chen: Thanks 680. Quick ask: keep intake to one page and aim for <48h turnaround on invites.
